missingVisualChecks: Closed corrugated container, roomy aisle, sandalwood logs and reading corner.
Recognizable seated Pushpa reading Japanese; handoff does not erase the truck beneath the car.
All coaches remain visible on continuous real tracks; no roof gap traps the car.
VVR Ram likeness/wardrobe and grounded figure remain stable through reversals.
Devara is behind the intact skeleton, hands on its neck, framed ahead of the Roadster.
Correct Devara likeness, costume and fixed grip survive the handover.
Existing restaurant facade is retained; roof cable is attached, basket is large and open.
Pizza remains visible in the basket throughout the lift. No Odela face is required.
Haunted property, webs, gate and aged scenery are legible from the driving camera.
Arundhati appears behind the gate in the correct film appearance.
Blue saree, loose hair and Ye Maaya Chesave resemblance.
Feet contact the street with natural gait; no sliding rigid body or teleport at path ends.
The entrance remains clear of real roads/buildings.
Bommarillu Hasini is recognizable and positioned behind the gate/pillar.
This is a wedding procession on a village street, not a static wedding venue.
Fidaa Bhanumathi dances with articulated limbs and remains recognizable during the handoff.
The angled bay, studio entrance and handoff point are readable.
Sukumar resembles the approved real director reference.
Four visible correct-film people exit the proper door onto the physical platform.
Vakeel Saab lawyer costume, three companion appearances and natural walking are independently approved.
Villa number and frontage read clearly; scenery does not pretend to verify a private address.
The director is recognizable.
Tall fortified industrial walls evoke the approved fictional Salaar set.
Gates/colliders agree and the entire car exits. No Prabhas model is required.
A doorway/room identity and medical classroom context replace an isolated number post.
Arjun Reddy appearance matches the film reference.
Original oval field, wicket, stands and floodlights remain; no roads/traffic or duplicate pitch.
Jersey Nani is recognizable and physically present at the handoff.

environment.refreshCapability: Not measured by this callback observer

performance.measurement: Focused, unblocked gameplay observer-callback cadence after the real simulation advances
limitations: Not GPU-completed presentation timing or input latency.
Device, refresh capability, thermal state and battery life require separate hardware evidence.
Hidden, unfocused, loading, map, pause and blocking-dialog intervals are excluded.
The existing Engine resets renderer counters once per frame and aggregates its scene, shadow and composer passes; these are submitted render counts, not GPU completion timing.
Optional JS heap and WebGL resource counts do not measure full device or GPU memory.
Resource timeline retains up to the latest3600 one-second samples; cadence totals cover the session.
Explicit QA HUD-isolation and scene-capture actions are diagnostic assistance, not representative gameplay-performance samples.
